thread:
Maya (AE): quick ask Veridian Health wants a special pricing + extended terms for a pilot. 90-day pilot, avg 150k toks/day, customer requests 45% off hosted list + Net45 payment terms to align with hospital PO cycles. tagging finance + revops.
Priya K: Net45 plus >30% discount is an exception. need explicit business case and conversion signal. whats the conversion probability?
Maya (AE): Sec review is positive, they expect Dedicated after pilot. Sales estimates 50% chance to convert. projected ARR on convert ~ $48k/mo. Pilot commitment $18k/mo (at requested discount).
Marco (Finance): Net effect = revenue timing + margin impact. at 150k tok/day our infra cost ~ $0.018/1k -> ~82/mo infra. main issue is cash flow with Net45 + big discount. Can we ask for partial upfront or ACH?
Li (RevOps): we can require a 25% deposit to mitigate Net45 risk and track credit in SFDC. also recommend a retro-credit on conversion to reach 45% only if they sign Dedicated within 60 days of pilot end.
Hannah (Legal): if Net45 accepted, include non-payment remedies and no-auto-renew at discounted rate. also need PHI/data addendum if they test with any patient data.
finance-bot: Policy: pilot_discount_cap = 30%. >30% requires Finance Dir + RevOps + Legal signoff. Upload deal-desk request: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk/new
Priya K: proposal: provisional approval for 35% discount + Net45 with 25% deposit, plus 10% retrospective credit if they convert to Dedicated within 60 days (bringing effective to 45%). Legal to draft amendment; RevOps to create deposit and credit flow. Marco to confirm finance signoff.
Marco (Finance): I can provisionally approve 35% + Net45 with 25% deposit and the retro-credit structure. Any above 35% needs VP Finance. Conditions: deal-desk entry, signed SOW + deposit received, legal amendment on terms.
Maya (AE): filing the deal-desk now and sending deposit clause to customer. will attach SOW and forecast.
Li (RevOps): created ticket FIN-5123 and SFDC tag VER-PILOT-2026. I'll implement the credit automation and deposit tracking.
Hannah (Legal): drafting amendment and PHI addendum. ping me the NDA and Ill include payment fallback language.
Priya K: marking provisional 35% + Net45 with deposit approved. final after docs & deposit. :white_check_mark:
Maya (AE): thanks all, will post links once uploaded.
